name: recoil_app_mfc_ole_module_constructor
description: RecoilApp::MfcOleModuleConstructor builds the MFC/OLE app base, initializes state-queue runtime fields, installs the MFC/OLE module vtable, and clears the state stack.
known_limits: Current VC5SP3 COFF byte compare passes through recoil_app_mfc_ole_module_constructor_s with zero unmasked mismatches after 8 relocation-masked bytes; the owner manifest uses vc5_o2_ob1_md_recoilapp_stl_queue_facs so VC5 sees the recovered std::deque state-queue member for this constructor.
The native smoke verifies pending/current/skip-wait fields, empty state queue, and cleared state stack on the host-compatible recovered queue layout.
